name: Translucent Leaf Triptych – Set of 3 Wooden Frame Wall Art Panels with Double Tape for Easy Mounting (Available in Two Sizes)
description: Bring depth and contrast to your space with this striking triptych featuring translucent leaves on a black backdrop. Each panel is crafted with a solid wooden frame and showcases a unique composition—ranging from layered foliage to a singular leaf in rich autumnal tones. Available in two formats (8×11 inches and 12×16 inches), this set arrives ready to mount with included double-sided tape, making installation seamless and tool-free. Ideal for bedrooms, lounges, or creative studios seeking a bold visual anchor.
